deleteAccountPage.introParagraph: IoTeam Software e Aplicativos, owner of Qualifai, values its users' privacy and freedom of choice. This Account Deletion Policy explains how you can request the deletion of your account and associated personal data, as well as what information may be retained to comply with legal obligations or legitimate interests.

deletionRequest.title: 1. Deletion Request
deletionRequest.paragraph: The user can, at any time, request the update or deletion of their data through the following channels:

deletionConditions.title: 2. Conditions for Deletion
deletionConditions.paragraph: Data will be deleted as quickly as possible when:
conditions: There is no longer a legitimate business need to retain it.
The related product or service ceases operation.
Deletion is requested by the user or required by the company to protect users.
The user cancels or no longer has an account (except anonymized data).
Deletion is required by law or regulation.
The data was received in error.

dataRetention.title: 3. Data Retention
dataRetention.paragraph: Even after deletion, we may retain certain information for the period necessary to:
conditions: Comply with legal or regulatory obligations.
Comply with tax and accounting obligations.

autoCancellation.title: 4. Automatic Cancellation
autoCancellation.paragraph: The account may be automatically deleted if:
conditions: A serious violation of the Terms of Use or Privacy Policy is identified;
Misuse, fraudulent, or illegal use of the platform is detected.

cancellationDeadlines.title: 5. Cancellation and Deadlines
cancellationDeadlines.paragraph: The data subject may, at any time, exercise their rights to cancel the contracted plan.
conditions: 7 calendar days from the date the plan was contracted (Proportional payment for services used may apply)
At any time, upon user request, with proportional value retention for services already used

userRights.title: 6. User Rights
userRights.paragraph: The data subject may, at any time, exercise their rights provided for in the General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13.709/2018), including:
conditions: Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data.
Data portability to another provider, upon explicit request.
Elimination of data processed with consent.

contact.title: 7. Contact

salesMethodologies.mainTitle: Our AI masters the main<1/>sales methodologies

SPIN.name: SPIN Selling
SPIN.explanation: Focused on asking the right questions to guide the client to the solution, exploring Situation, Problem, Implication, and Need-payoff.

chat.text: Hello! To understand your scenario, can you describe your current sales process?
Sure. It's quite manual; we use spreadsheets for almost everything.
I see. And what is the biggest challenge this manual process creates for you?
The sales cycle is very long. It takes us weeks to qualify a lead.
I can imagine the impact of that. Has this slowness ever caused you to lose deals to competitors?
Yes, several times. It's frustrating.
So, a solution that automates tasks and speeds up the cycle would be a priority for you?
Absolutely! That would be exactly what we need.
Perfect. Analysis complete: Lead qualified via SPIN.

SPICE.name: SPICE
SPICE.explanation: Maps the Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical Event (what happens if nothing is done), and Evaluation criteria for success.

chat.text: Analyzing your workflow, which task consumes the most of your team's time?
Generating monthly reports. It's a headache.
Let's quantify the impact. How many work hours are spent on these reports?
Easily about 80 hours a month, a significant operational cost.
Right. And what is the critical event if nothing changes and demand doubles next quarter?
The team wouldn't cope, data quality would drop, and it would affect our decisions.
Okay. And how would you evaluate the success of a new solution for this?
If we can generate accurate reports in under 5 minutes, it would be a win.
Clear metrics. Analysis complete: Lead qualified via SPICE.

BANT.name: BANT
BANT.explanation: A quick qualification framework to focus on high-potential leads by validating Budget, Authority, Need, and Timeline.

chat.text: To be efficient, let's validate a few points. Do you have a defined budget for new tools?
Yes, we have an approved budget of up to $15k for the right tool.
Great. And who else is involved in the final purchase decision?
I do the evaluation, but the Sales Director gives the final approval.
Understood. The main need is to increase team productivity, correct?
Exactly. Less time on administrative tasks, more time selling.
And what is the timeline to have this solution implemented and generating results?
Ideally, we'd like to start next quarter.
Excellent. Analysis complete: Lead qualified via BANT.

MEDDIC.name: MEDDIC
MEDDIC.explanation: Ideal for complex B2B sales, ensuring deep qualification by analyzing Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Pain, and a Champion.

chat.text: Starting in-depth analysis. Which business metric (KPI) do you most need to impact right now?
We need to decrease our Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) by 20%.
A clear goal. Who is the economic buyer that approves projects with this impact?
That would be our CFO; he approves all investments over $20k.
Right. And what are the most important technical criteria for you?
Integration with our CRM, data security, and agile support.
Noted. And what happens if the CAC doesn't decrease? What is the real pain?
Our profit margin will be compromised, and we'll have to cut other investments.
I understand the urgency. Analysis complete: Lead qualified via MEDDIC.

blogPost.title: The Future of Lead Qualification: How Qualifai's AI Enhances Sales Methodologies
blogPost.excerpt: Discover how artificial intelligence can transform your support, offering instant, personalized responses available 24/7, freeing up your team to focus on complex cases.
blogPost.content:
"The SPIN Selling methodology provides guidance on the right questions to ask in a sales process to increase conversion rates." - RD Station [1]

SPICED: A Comprehensive View of the Customer's Scenario

SPICED is a framework that goes beyond the problem, analyzing the Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical Event, and Decision Criteria. This methodology allows for a deeper understanding of the customer's scenario and their buying motivations. Qualifai's AI uses SPICED to qualify leads even more accurately, ensuring that only the hottest opportunities reach the sales team.

"SPICED helps structure conversations that generate value from the first minute, revealing what the lead was not yet clear about." - Pipelovers [2]

Qualifai in Action

Qualifai's platform integrates with WhatsApp and Instagram, conversing with leads through personalized text, audio, and calls. The AI qualifies leads, schedules meetings directly in Google Calendar, and updates the CRM, creating an automatic and frictionless sales flow. And most importantly: Qualifai's AI works 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, ensuring no lead is lost.

Conclusion

The combination of Artificial Intelligence with established sales methodologies like SPIN Selling and SPICED is revolutionizing lead qualification. Qualifai is at the forefront of this transformation, offering a solution that not only optimizes the sales process but also boosts results, allowing companies to turn their sales funnels into predictable profit.
